title: Window membership from core-summary equality
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $c,d$ be configurations on $x$ for a machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$. If they have the same state, input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions, and their output words have the same summary (empty, exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, or unable ever to become $[\mathrm{true}]$), then if every work-tape head of $d$ lies within distance $s$ of the origin and every cell of each work tape outside that interval is blank, the same properties hold for $c$.
